## Behavior and reproduction

Describe what happened, what you expected, and the shortest reproduction.

## Environment

Include the Koma revision, distribution, kernel, session/backend, GPU and driver, output configuration, and relevant toolchain versions. Redact private application contents from logs and screenshots.

## Evidence

Attach logs and state whether this was a headless test, nested Wayland session, VM, or physical GPU run.
